svg.title: How Goose recipes, extensions, skills, and plugins fit together
svg.desc: A Recipe configures a Goose agent: its instructions, its enabled extensions, and its sub-recipes for delegation. Extensions are the base mechanism, including two built-in ones relevant here: the Skills extension, which discovers skills from a registry of folders, and the Summon extension, which delegates tasks to sub-agents using skills and recipes as sources. A plugin is an optional bundle that installs into three separate places at once: the skill registry, a set of recipes, and shared config — it does not route through any one of them.

g.text: Built-in platform extensions or external MCP servers
